setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_computed_sales (region int4, price int4, adjustment int4)

INSERT INTO bench_computed_sales SELECT CASE WHEN i%97=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%32 END, CASE WHEN i%11=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%1001-500 END, CASE WHEN i%13=0 THEN NULL ELSE i%101-50 END FROM generate_series(1,250000) s(i)
